traceability.notes: The story 007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING is fully implemented and verified. All specified rules (require-story-annotation, require-req-annotation, require-branch-annotation, valid-annotation-format, valid-story-reference, valid-req-reference) expose clear, specific, and consistent error messages via meta.messages with the documented placeholders (functionName, missing, details, path/storyPath/reqId). Plugin configuration tests confirm severity conventions (errors for missing/invalid references, warning for purely format issues). All these tests pass in the full Jest run. This provides concrete evidence that all acceptance criteria and per-requirement behaviors in the story are met.
